checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: First image retains silhouette, matte black finish, lid details on plain white
must.why: Shape and lid match closely; slightly crushed black, flatter shading, mild halo/off-white edge, but largely preserved.

must.item: No table or original background in first image
must.why: Background is plain white with faint off-white blotches.

must.item: Second image realistic bottle on rock by mountain lake at sunrise
must.why: Bottle upright on lichen rock, lake, mountains, warm sunrise glow.

faults.what: First image bottle is not completely unchanged: darker and flatter, lost subtle shading and base detail, slightly different perspective/edge halo; background faintly mottled off-white rather than pure white.

Second image bottle is slightly redesigned: lid ring and loop are more defined, and the bottle is wider and shorter than the source. It also looks a bit like a composite, with its shadow and lighting only loosely matching the scene.

summary: Both square images are delivered with no text: a good white-background cutout with slight tonal and edge degradation, and a realistic sunrise lake scene with a bottle that is close to the original but slightly altered.
